description: llama.cpp fork with the Neuralese ports (S4 §6). A separate git checkout, not vendored: core patch = layer-range execution (src/llama-ext.h llama_set_layer_range, LFM2 graph); library + tools in tools/neuralese.
working_status: 2d6557813: parity with the reference server (template value_type "unknown" and argument_path, parts typed unknown, POST /v1/neuralese/embed, Qwen <tool_call> JSON calls and a lone </think> parsed as the reference's chat.build_message, streamed chat completions in the reference's chunk format: native chunked transfer, wasm through nzw_handle's event hook; info fields aligned, decide_many item errors "code: detail", HEAD and other methods 405); only grad, optim and adapter creation/export/projection stay reference-only. The vendored browser wasm (ts-host/vendor/neuralese-wasm) is built from this commit. Earlier: 43b495c73 POST /v1/neuralese/view replaces /digest; batched decision readout; full-residual-v1 reader adapter in nz_read (raw-token and latent-sketch projectors remain unsupported; this does not qualify the new foundation C++ runtime).
build_cpu: cmake -S . -B build-cpu -G Ninja -DGGML_CUDA=OFF -DGGML_OPENMP=OFF -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_SERVER=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build-cpu --target llama-neuralese-parity llama-neuralese-server -j2

checks: forced write: length, truncation, payload, stop logits
read of an uploaded block: greedy continuation
text encoding (with and without a context)
digest plan: single site and chunked at window 16
template readout: written and decoded values
length hints: position by position and block-wise (1 and all passes)
rendered prompts (plain, tools, tool calls with results, a reply returning a written value as a block)
guidance: reply checks on fixed replies (syntax, line repetition, in-line run, redeclaration, unknown tool), guided rollback and retry
weight adapters: an xs adapter (adapter/2) exported as a GGUF LoRA gives the reference's decision log-probabilities and greedy reply; unloaded adapters fail 409, projection-decoded ones 501
batched decision scoring (/v1/natlang/score, /v1/neuralese/decide_many): each item equals decide alone, a bad item fails alone
shared error behaviour: 405 method-not-allowed, 404 not-found, 400 bad-json for a non-object body and for a malformed collect
batched scoring groups same-prompt items across the request and answers in request order

one capability model: info.server and sorted info.capabilities on both; every capability the fork lacks (grad, grad.order2, optim, adapters.create, adapters.direct, adapters.lora-export, adapters.projection) answers 501 neuralese-<capability>-unavailable; the reference answers PUT …/lora 501

fork parity: info fields of the same shape, embed (identical content IDs), template value_type unknown and argument_path (write and decode, refused paths), parts typed unknown render unquoted (given or stored type), Qwen <tool_call> JSON calls and a lone </think>, streamed replies (role, held-back call markup, block parts, tool_calls, x_natlang_message) assembled equal to the non-streamed reply and equal across servers, stream error events, guidance {} on both, batched item errors "code: detail", neuralese-bad-block for a block of another width, HEAD/PATCH/OPTIONS 405, collect with a non-list referenced 400
server_conformance.result: 75 passed on DGX CPU: 25 shallow, 25 final (native build-cpu), 25 final-wasm (vendored wasm built from the same commit); test_runtime_versions and test_serve.py pass; final-wasm-mt (opt-in) deadlocks intermittently under Node (open)
